messages:
marta.k: Heads up — while onboarding the quantized q4-small variant for latency experiments we saw a consistent dip on the multi-turn summarization cohort. I want to refresh the golden cohort and rejigger the annotation batches before the next smoke.

kei: What does the regression look like? ROUGE drop or hallucination increase?

marta.k: Mostly coherence drop + ~6% ROUGE-L on the long-turn subset (3+ turns). Small hallucination uptick in our safety checks. Baseline (fp16) is fine. This only shows up after quant at 4-bit in some seeds.

zach.label: We can do a golden refresh. Two asks: (1) de-dupe the incoming pool against current golden by embedding-sim > 0.92, (2) reserve 150 examples covering long-turns, clarifying Q/A vs instruction style. My team has capacity next Tues/Wed.

kei: For de-dupe I'd run locality-sensitive hashing + a trimmed token shingle pass first, then embed for final check. Example commands we used previously:
```bash
python scripts/fast_shingle_dedupe.py --input pool.jsonl --shingle-size 5 --threshold 0.8 --out trimmed.jsonl
python scripts/embed_and_filter.py --input trimmed.jsonl --model all-mpnet-base --sim-threshold 0.92 --golden golden.jsonl --out new_candidates.jsonl
```
That keeps cost low before doing embed comparisons.

zach.label: Yep that workflow works. Also we should mark edge-cases for manual review (long context + multiple references). I'll annotate the first 300 for labeler-leads and surface a priority tag.

labeler-leads: Can confirm — we need the tag schema: {"multi_ref": bool, "requires_chaining": bool, "safety_flag": bool}. Also prefer 3-way review on the new golden items.

sanjay.pm: From product side: prioritize examples that reflect customer flows (support threads, multi-user chat). Also include a few reg-extracted failure cases from the fp16->quant diff.

marta.k: Good. Action plan: (1) kei to run fast_shingle_dedupe on the raw pool by EOD, (2) zach to kick embedding filter and prepare 300 candidate set by Tue, (3) labeler-leads to run 3-way reviews and tag the golden cohort, (4) eval-bot to run a quant-smoke afterwards and post metrics.

kei: Starting shingle pass now. ETA 6h. I'll push trimmed.jsonl to /mnt/curation/q4-quant/trimmed.

zach.label: I'll schedule embedding runs on g4dn tomorrow morning and create labeling batches with the tag schema. Also adding a quick labeling guide note: "Preserve core facts unless contradicted by later context; when in doubt mark 'requires_chaining'."

eval-bot: initial quant-smoke (seed 42) queued once golden is published. Smoke will compare fp16 vs q4-small on: ROUGE-L, ExactMatch (QA), hallucination score, latency p50/p95.

marta.k: Thanks all. If we see the same regression after the fresh golden, next step is an ablation: kv-cache padding + alternative quantization backend (gemmlowp->fbgemm) before rolling back.

zach.label: Noted. I'll also add a small prompt perturbation set to test brittleness.

labeler-leads: We'll sync after the first 3-way pass and provide a short summary doc with examples of disagreements.

marta.k: Perfect — follow-ups in thread. :thumbsup:
